messages:
Ellen (Head of Eng): quick follow-up from the all-hands about the FY26 headcount envelope. posting a few clarifications here and happy to take Qs for the next hour. link to the short note: https://redwood.example.com/allhands/fy26-brief :wave:

Rina (People Ops): TL;DR: headcount approved in tranches. managers may draft reqs now but hires will be released by tranche. intake form + req template in the playbook.

Ben - Eng: what's the tranche cadence? curious how fast we can convert drafts into open roles.

Tom (Finance): plan is 3 tranches: immediate (Q1 hires), mid (Q2), and contingent (late FY). immediate tranche is ~40% of the envelope and will be released next Monday; mid tranche in ~8 weeks. contingent depends on top-line and runway checks.

Sofia - PM: does tranche assignment change how approvals work? i.e., do hires in later tranches need re-approval?

Rina (People Ops): hires in mid/contingent tranches still require the same intake + hiring approval but may be subject to updated comp bands or headcount rebalancing. leadership will reconfirm mid tranche before roles go live.

Ben - Eng: any guidance on contractor vs FTE for accelerated needs? we have a short-term performance burst that might be contractor-friendly.

Tom (Finance): contractors ok for short-term gaps but we prefer FTEs for long-lived product work. finance will approve contractor spend on a case-by-case basis; include duration & deliverables in the intake notes.

Ellen (Head of Eng): a couple more things	6: 1) matrix/reporting questions: teams moving under Platform Director will keep dotted lines for product area leads, 2) promotions: internal promotions don't consume new headcount but still need comp band sign-off.

Rina (People Ops): confirm: promotions = no new headcount, but please file the promotion packet early so comp can be signed off before start date.

Sofia - PM: can managers request early recruiter outreach before tranche release? would help passive candidates.

Rina (People Ops): yes recruiters can do passive outreach if you note "prep_outreach":true on the intake. roles still won't be posted externally until tranche release and comp bands are set.

Ben - Eng: small ask: for Dedicated infra hires, can we get a country-by-country legal checklist? EMEA candidates have different paperwork.

Rina (People Ops): will share a checklist. for new-country hires expect 2-3 weeks for legal review; flag location on intake so we can prep.

Tom (Finance): note on budget: hiring runway reviewed monthly. if revenue lags we'll pause contingent tranche. please avoid long candidate holds that cross tranche decisions.

Ellen (Head of Eng): last: please use prefix TR1-/TR2-/TRC- for tranche tracking in req names, e.g., TR1-infra-eng-2. helps reporting and allocation.

Hiring Bot: Reminder: intake form -> https://redwood.example.com/hr/intake (auto-post)

Ben - Eng: thanks. i'll start drafting TR1 reqs and mark prep_outreach true.

Sofia - PM: appreciate the clarity. can People Ops post a one-pager on tranche rules + escalation path?

Rina (People Ops): yes	6 will post a one-pager and a short FAQ by EOD. leadership will review escalations weekly.

Ellen (Head of Eng): thanks team. i'll monitor this thread for 30 mins. DM me for anything sensitive. :thumbsup:
